I called to make an appointment with a Dr as I submitted an online form 10days ago which is what they recommend (they also state they will get back to you in a few working days) so due to not hearing back I decided to call to make an appointment for my scan results to be viewed by a Dr to see if I need an operation. Just for a bit of background myself and my husband are currently going through a very emotive health situation in regards to having a baby.

I called and requested an appointment with Dr Thomas as I find she listens, understands and actually cares for individuals and their health concerns plus she is a female and I feel more comfortable talking about fertility with a female (I think there is nothing wrong with that)

I waited about two minutes on hold for the receptionist to inform me an appointment was made on the 22nd August for me. This appointment I now know to be was for a separate health condition from an EClinic submission I made about 3 weeks before 22nd August so it was nothing to do with what I was calling the drs for.
